meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库,找出可深化的架构改进点并生成可视化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接手了结构混乱的老代码,想先摸清该从哪儿动手改
copy.tagline_en: Scan a codebase, find architecture improvement spots, and chart them visually
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherited a messy codebase and want to know where to start

howto.what: 扫描代码库,找出把浅模块变深的「深化机会」,生成一份 HTML 报告——含涉及文件、问题、方案、收益、前后对比图和推荐强度徽章——写到系统临时目录并打开给你看。你选中一个后,它陪你把相关决策逐一走一遍。
howto.when: 需你手动调用,禁用了模型自动触发,不会自行启动。你若指定了模块或痛点就按它来;否则它先翻 git 提交历史找出改动热点,再据此扫描。

say.text: 扫描一下这个代码库,把深化机会做成 HTML 报告给我
say.note: 报告写到系统临时目录并打开

say.text: 重点看看 payments 模块有没有可深化的地方
say.note: 指定方向后跳过热点推断

say.text: 我想深入聊报告里的第一个候选方案

howto.what_en: Scans a codebase for deepening opportunities (refactors that turn shallow modules into deep ones), writes a self-contained HTML report to the OS temp dir with before/after diagrams, opens it, then walks the decision tree for whichever you pick.
howto.when_en: Manual invocation only (model auto-invocation is disabled). It starts when you call it, optionally naming a module or pain point; otherwise it reads git history to find hot spots first.

say_en.text: Scan this codebase and give me an HTML report of deepening opportunities
say_en.note: Writes report to temp dir and opens it

say_en.text: Focus on the payments module for deepening opportunities
Let's grill through the first candidate in the report
